identity.name: Chronograph
identity.one_liner: The platinum finale of the 5170 line — Patek's in-house manual chronograph with a blue dial and baguette diamond markers.

narrative.story: The 5170 was the reference that moved Patek's classic chronograph off the Lemania-based CH 27-70 and onto the in-house CH 29-535 PS. After yellow, white and rose gold versions, the platinum 5170P-001 arrived in 2017 with a blue sunburst dial and baguette diamond hour markers, ran only briefly, and gave way to the 5172G in 2019. Short production and end-of-line status made it the collected one.
narrative.collector_notes: Look for the diamond set between the lugs at 6 — the platinum tell. The short run means few examples circulate; condition of the concave bezel and the sharp lug facets separates untouched pieces from polished ones.
